Sokuji is the voice translator. It is not dictation and it is not Speak.
https://github.com/kizuna-ai-lab/sokuji
License: AGPL-3.0
Offline translation model: https://github.com/Helsinki-NLP/Opus-MT (MIT code, CC-BY 4.0 weights)

The SamirPaul real-time translator was rejected because it calls Google.
The Opus-MT weights are not loaded in this browser. No Google host is called.
